messages.subject: compareGroups Forum launched!
parts:
Welcome to the compare~Groups Forum!

Soon we'll be kicking off this forum with a series of topics on the main features of the latest version (2.0) of compareGroups.
In the meantime, feel free to add yourself as a member of this forum (you can have new topics automatically emailed to you), or sign up for our main mailing list to receive general news about compareGroups. Of course, if you're already a compareGroups user and have a question or have found a bug, you can post it right now, and and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.

--
The compareGroups Team
